<!doctype html>
<html lang="id"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<script>
(function(){
  // Pulihkan pengguna dari Service Worker/cache versi lama jika pernah ada.
  if('serviceWorker' in navigator){
    navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(function(regs){
      return Promise.all(regs.map(function(r){return r.unregister()}));
    }).then(function(){
      if(!sessionStorage.getItem('nebo_v2_cache_refresh')){
        sessionStorage.setItem('nebo_v2_cache_refresh','1');
        location.reload();
      }
    }).catch(function(){});
  }
})();
</script>
<title>NEBO STORE — Fashion Discovery</title>
<meta name="application-name" content="NEBO STORE V2">
<style>
:root{--black:#080808;--gray:#f3f3f3;--line:#dedede;--muted:#777;--accent:#d9ff45;--soft:#f7f7f2}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;color:var(--black);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;background:#fff}
button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}
header{height:72px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 5vw;position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;z-index:20}
.logo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:42px;width:auto;font-size:28px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:4px;line-height:1;color:#111;text-decoration:none}.logo img{width:42px;height:42px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px}nav{display:flex;gap:25px}nav button{background:none;border:0;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em}
.hero{padding:90px 5vw 75px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:50px;align-items:end}
.kicker,.eyebrow{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:700;color:#666;margin-bottom:20px}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(50px,8vw,115px);line-height:.84;letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:0}
.hero-copy{max-width:430px;color:#555;line-height:1.65;font-size:14px}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--black);background:var(--black);color:#fff;padding:14px 19px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em}
.section{padding:55px 5vw}.topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:25px;gap:20px}
h2{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:0}.search{width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #111;padding:14px 0;margin-bottom:25px;outline:0}
.filters{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.filter{background:#fff;border:1px solid #bbb;padding:9px 13px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}.filter.active{background:#111;color:#fff;border-color:#111}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px}.card{min-width:0}.pic{cursor:pointer;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:#f0f0f0;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;padding:11px}.tag{background:#fff;padding:7px;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}.pictext{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#999}
.info{padding:14px 0}.type{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#777;font-weight:700}.info h3{font-size:15px;margin:7px 0 14px}.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}.price{font-weight:700;font-size:13px}.view{border:0;background:none;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em}
footer{background:#080808;color:#fff;padding:50px 5vw;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:30px}footer img{height:58px;filter:invert(1)}footer p{color:#aaa;font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;max-width:320px}
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.45);z-index:50;display:none}.modal{background:#fff;width:min(620px,92vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;margin:5vh auto;padding:28px}.overlay.show{display:block}
.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:25px}.close{border:0;background:none;font-size:24px}.field{margin-bottom:15px}.field label{display:block;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:7px}.field input,.field textarea,.field select{width:100%;border:1px solid #ccc;padding:11px;outline:0}.field textarea{min-height:85px;resize:vertical}.admin-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
.admin-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px}.admin-table th,.admin-table td{border-bottom:1px solid #ddd;text-align:left;padding:13px 8px}.admin-table th{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em}.small{padding:8px 10px;font-size:9px;background:#111;color:#fff;border:0}.small.delete{background:#fff;color:#111;border:1px solid #111}
.detail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:35px}.detail-photo{background:#f1f1f1;min-height:480px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#aaa;font-size:11px}.detail h1{font-size:42px;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:0 0 12px}.desc{color:#666;line-height:1.7;font-size:14px;margin:20px 0 30px}
@media(max-width:850px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.hero,.detail{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding:65px 20px}.section{padding:40px 20px}header{padding:0 20px}nav{gap:8px}.detail-photo{min-height:350px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.hero h1{font-size:58px}.topline{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}footer{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}}

/* NEBO v4 enhancements */
.featured-section{padding-top:10px}.featured-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;margin-bottom:18px}.featured-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:700}.featured-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}.featured-card{position:relative}.featured-badge{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:7px 9px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:700;z-index:2}.controlbar{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0 22px}.controlbar .search{flex:1;min-width:220px;margin:0}.controlbar select{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:11px;background:#fff;font-size:10px;min-width:150px}.admin-toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:22px 0}.admin-toolbar input,.admin-toolbar select{border:1px solid #ccc;padding:11px;background:#fff;font-size:10px}.admin-toolbar input{flex:1;min-width:200px}.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;margin:25px 0}.stat{border:1px solid #ddd;padding:18px}.stat small{display:block;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#777}.stat strong{display:block;font-size:24px;margin-top:6px}.featured-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;margin:12px 0}.featured-toggle input{width:auto}.admin-product{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.admin-thumb{width:42px;height:52px;background:#f1f1f1;object-fit:cover;flex:none}.badge-on{display:inline-block;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:5px 7px;font-size:8px}.badge-off{display:inline-block;background:#eee;color:#666;padding:5px 7px;font-size:8px}
@media(max-width:850px){.featured-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.stat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:520px){.featured-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stat-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.login-section{min-height:55vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.login-card{width:min(430px,100%);border:1px solid #ddd;padding:32px;background:#fff}.login-card h2{margin:8px 0 10px}.login-card .btn{width:100%;margin-top:10px}
/* NEBO STORE PREMIUM UPGRADE */
:root{--accent:#111;--soft:#f7f7f5;--radius:16px}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{background:#fff}header{backdrop-filter:blur(12px);background:rgba(255,255,255,.94)}
header>a{display:flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none}.logo{font-size:30px;letter-spacing:5px}
nav button{transition:opacity .2s,transform .2s}nav button:hover{opacity:.55;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.hero{min-height:410px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#fafafa,#fff);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.hero:after{content:'NEBO';position:absolute;right:-20px;bottom:-55px;font-size:180px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.08em;color:#f1f1ef;pointer-events:none}.hero>div{position:relative;z-index:1}
.btn,.view,.small,.filter{transition:all .2s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0001}.view:hover{opacity:.6}.filter{border-radius:999px!important}.filter.active{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #111}
.card{border:1px solid #e8e8e8;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}.card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 14px 35px #0000000d}.pic{cursor:pointer;position:relative;background:#f4f4f2;min-height:250px}.pic img{transition:transform .35s}.card:hover .pic img{transform:scale(1.035)}.tag{border-radius:999px!important}.featured-badge{border-radius:999px}.info{padding:15px}.info h3{min-height:38px}.row{gap:10px}.price{font-weight:800}
.controlbar select{border-radius:999px}.search{font-size:14px}.empty-state{padding:40px 15px;text-align:center;color:#777;border:1px dashed #ddd;border-radius:14px}
.product-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}.product-actions button{flex:1}.heart-btn{width:42px!important;flex:0 0 42px!important;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#fff;border-radius:999px}.heart-btn.saved{background:#111;color:#fff;border-color:#111}
.detail-photo{border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#f5f5f3}.detail-photo img{display:block}.detail-photo[role="button"]:focus{outline:2px solid #111;outline-offset:-2px}.pic[role="button"]:focus{outline:2px solid #111;outline-offset:-2px}.image-viewer img{max-width:94vw;max-height:90vh;cursor:zoom-out}.detail h1{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,58px);letter-spacing:-.06em}.detail .btn{margin-top:20px}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);background:#111;color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s;z-index:100}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
.loading-note{padding:28px 0;color:#777;font-size:12px}.admin-table{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden}.stat{border-radius:14px;background:#fff}.stat strong{letter-spacing:-.04em}

/* PRODUCT DETAIL AESTHETIC */
.detail-page{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fafaf8 0%,#fff 45%);border-radius:24px;margin:22px 5vw 55px;padding:28px clamp(18px,4vw,55px) 55px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.detail-page>.view{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.detail-page>.view:hover{transform:translateX(-3px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.detail{gap:clamp(24px,5vw,70px);align-items:center}
.detail-photo{min-height:clamp(360px,62vh,650px);border-radius:24px;background:#f1f1ed;box-shadow:0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.09);position:relative;isolation:isolate}
.detail-photo:after{content:'CLICK TO ZOOM';position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:16px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);color:#fff;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-size:8px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.14em;pointer-events:none;opacity:.85}
.detail-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:inherit;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .45s ease,filter .3s}.detail-photo:hover img{transform:scale(1.025);filter:brightness(.98)}
.detail-copy{padding:10px 0}.detail-copy .eyebrow{display:inline-block;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:8px}.detail-copy h1{font-weight:900;margin:14px 0 12px}.detail-price{font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.05em}.price-disclaimer{margin:10px 0 22px;padding:13px 15px;background:#f5f5f1;border:1px solid #e5e5df;border-radius:12px;color:#707070;font-size:11px;line-height:1.6}.product-actions{align-items:stretch;gap:10px}.product-actions .btn{flex:1;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px}.heart-btn{height:50px!important;border-radius:12px!important;font-size:20px}.detail-note{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#999}.detail-meta span{padding:6px 0}
@media(max-width:850px){.detail-page{margin:12px 0 35px;border-radius:0;padding:22px 20px 40px}.detail-photo{min-height:420px}.detail{align-items:stretch}}
@media(max-width:520px){.detail-photo{min-height:390px;border-radius:18px}.detail-photo:after{font-size:7px}.detail-page{padding-left:15px;padding-right:15px}.product-actions .btn{padding:15px 10px}}

@media(max-width:800px){header{height:64px;padding:0 18px}nav{gap:12px}nav button{font-size:10px}.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:55px 22px 45px;min-height:0}.hero h1{font-size:52px}.hero:after{font-size:100px}.section{padding-left:22px;padding-right:22px}.featured-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.pic{cursor:pointer;min-height:180px}.info h3{font-size:14px;min-height:0}.price{font-size:13px}.view{font-size:9px}.stat-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.detail{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:25px!important}.detail-photo{max-height:430px}.admin-table{font-size:11px}}
@media(max-width:430px){.featured-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.pic{cursor:pointer;min-height:150px}.featured-badge{font-size:7px;padding:6px 8px}.tag{font-size:8px}.controlbar{gap:8px}.controlbar .search{min-width:100%;}.controlbar select{width:100%}.hero h1{font-size:44px}.logo{font-size:25px}}
.detail-copy h1{font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,58px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:14px 0 18px}.detail-price{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:24px}.detail-meta{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:800;border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:16px 0;margin:25px 0}.detail-note{font-size:11px;color:#888;line-height:1.6;margin-top:18px}.detail-page{padding-top:35px}.logo img{width:58px!important;height:58px!important;object-fit:contain;background:#fff;border-radius:10px}.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:58px}@media(max-width:430px){.logo img{width:48px!important;height:48px!important}} 
.image-viewer{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);z-index:100;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px}
.image-viewer.show{display:flex}.image-viewer img{max-width:94vw;max-height:90vh;object-fit:contain}
.image-viewer button{position:absolute;top:18px;right:20px;border:0;background:#fff;color:#111;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;font-size:24px}

/* NEBO STORE — visual upgrade, site settings & verification */
.site-settings-btn{border:1px solid #111;background:#fff;padding:9px 12px;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em}
.hero-upgraded{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a0a0a 0%,#181818 58%,#303030 100%);color:#fff;border-radius:0 0 28px 28px}
.hero-upgraded:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:420px;height:420px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:50%;right:-120px;top:-170px;box-shadow:0 0 0 70px rgba(255,255,255,.025),0 0 0 140px rgba(255,255,255,.018)}
.hero-upgraded h1{white-space:pre-line}.hero-upgraded .kicker{color:#c9c9c9}.hero-upgraded .hero-copy{color:#d0d0d0}.hero-upgraded .btn{background:#d9ff45;border-color:#d9ff45;color:#111}
.hero-badges{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:25px}.hero-badge{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);padding:8px 10px;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.14em}
.featured-section{position:relative;background:#f7f7f2;padding-top:65px;padding-bottom:65px}.featured-spotlight{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;min-height:440px;background:#111;color:#fff;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:28px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.spotlight-photo{min-height:440px;background:#e9e9e9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}.spotlight-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.spotlight-copy{padding:55px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}.spotlight-copy .eyebrow{color:#aaa}.spotlight-copy h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,66px);line-height:.94;margin:0 0 15px}.spotlight-price{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:18px}.spotlight-copy p{color:#bbb;line-height:1.7;font-size:13px;max-width:430px}.spotlight-copy .btn{align-self:flex-start;margin-top:18px}.social-strip{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:28px}.social-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;border:1px solid #ddd;background:#fff;color:#111;padding:10px 13px;text-decoration:none;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em}.social-link:hover{border-color:#111}
.verify-box{width:min(460px,92vw);background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 25px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.verify-title{font-size:24px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-bottom:8px}.verify-text{font-size:12px;color:#666;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:20px}.verify-slider{width:100%;accent-color:#111}.verify-track{background:#f1f1f1;border:1px solid #ddd;padding:13px;border-radius:10px}.verify-status{text-align:center;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:700;margin-top:10px;color:#777}.settings-logo-preview{width:100px;height:100px;object-fit:contain;background:#f3f3f3;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:12px;padding:8px}.settings-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.settings-grid .field.full{grid-column:1/-1}
@media(max-width:850px){.featured-spotlight{grid-template-columns:1fr}.spotlight-photo{min-height:340px}.spotlight-copy{padding:32px}.settings-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* NEBO STORE — stability, Top 10, feedback, responsive controls */
.top10-wrap{display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:6px 2px 20px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scrollbar-width:thin}
.top10-card{flex:0 0 min(300px,78vw);scroll-snap-align:start;border:1px solid #e5e5e5;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;position:relative;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0000000a}
.top10-card .pic{aspect-ratio:4/5;min-height:0}.top10-rank{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:12px;left:12px;background:#111;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 11px;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em}
.top10-sales{font-size:10px;color:#666;font-weight:700;margin-top:8px}.feedback-fab{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:35;border:0;background:#111;color:#fff;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0003}
.toggle-btn{border:1px solid #ccc;background:#fff;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:8px;font-weight:800}.toggle-btn.on{background:#111;color:#fff;border-color:#111}
.feedback-list{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:18px}.feedback-item{border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:12px;padding:14px}.feedback-item small{color:#777}.feedback-item p{margin:8px 0 0;line-height:1.55}
.bg-preview{width:100%;height:130px;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid #ddd;border-radius:12px;background:#f5f5f5}
body.has-custom-bg{background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-attachment:fixed;background-repeat:no-repeat}.has-custom-bg #app>.section:not(.featured-section){background:rgba(255,255,255,.96)}
/* NEBO STORE — aesthetic, motion & speed */
body{overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeSpeed}
#app>.section,#app>.hero{animation:pageIn .45s ease both}
@keyframes pageIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.985);transition:opacity .5s ease,transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}
.card:active,.top10-card:active{transform:scale(.985)}
.card .pic img,.spotlight-photo img{transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),filter .35s}
.card:hover .pic img,.top10-card:hover .pic img{transform:scale(1.055)}
.top10-wrap{scroll-behavior:smooth;overscroll-behavior-x:contain}
.top10-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar{height:6px}.top10-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#bbb;border-radius:99px}
.selected-section{background:#fff;padding-bottom:35px}.selected-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:20px}
.section-kicker{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;font-weight:800;color:#777;margin-bottom:8px}
@media(max-width:850px){.selected-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media(max-width:430px){.selected-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}}

@media(max-width:600px){nav{gap:4px}nav button{padding:8px 5px}.feedback-fab{right:12px;bottom:12px}.admin-toolbar select,.admin-toolbar input{width:100%}.modal{padding:20px}.top10-card{flex-basis:76vw}}


/* NEBO V2 — SPEED + MOBILE + FEATURED REFINEMENT */
.login-card{border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 55px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}
.login-card p:empty{display:none}
.login-card .btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
.boot-shell{min-height:62vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:60px 20px}
.boot-loader{width:min(360px,90vw);text-align:center}.boot-loader .bar{height:3px;background:#eee;overflow:hidden;border-radius:99px;margin-top:18px}.boot-loader .bar:after{content:"";display:block;height:100%;width:38%;background:#111;border-radius:99px;animation:neboLoad 1.05s ease-in-out infinite}.boot-loader small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#888;font-weight:700}@keyframes neboLoad{0%{transform:translateX(-110%)}100%{transform:translateX(290%)}}
/* Featured stays visual, but never dominates the page */
.featured-spotlight{grid-template-columns:minmax(220px,.72fr) minmax(0,1fr);min-height:300px;border-radius:20px;margin-bottom:22px}
.spotlight-photo{min-height:300px;max-height:330px}.spotlight-photo img{object-fit:cover}

<script>
(function () {
  function formatRupiahValue(value) {
    const digits = String(value ?? '').replace(/\D/g, '');
    if (!digits) return '';
    return 'Rp' + Number(digits).toLocaleString('id-ID');
  }

  function attachPriceFormatter() {
    const candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(
      'input, textarea, [contenteditable="true"]'
    ));

    candidates.forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.dataset.rupiahFormatterAttached) return;

      const label = el.closest('.field')?.querySelector('label')?.textContent || '';
      const hint = (
        (el.getAttribute('name') || '') + ' ' +
        (el.getAttribute('id') || '') + ' ' +
        (el.getAttribute('placeholder') || '') + ' ' + label
      ).toLowerCase();

      if (!/(harga|price)/.test(hint)) return;

      el.dataset.rupiahFormatterAttached = '1';

      el.addEventListener('input', function () {
        const raw = this.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
        if (!raw) {
          this.value = '';
          return;
        }
        this.value = formatRupiahValue(raw);
        try { this.setSelectionRange(this.value.length, this.value.length); } catch(e) {}
      });

      el.addEventListener('blur', function () {
        const raw = this.value.replace(/\D/g, '');
        this.value = raw ? formatRupiahValue(raw) : '';
      });
    });
  }

  // Format harga yang sudah tampil di halaman tanpa mengubah harga yang sudah berformat.
  function formatDisplayedPrices() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.price').forEach(function (el) {
      const raw = el.textContent.trim();
      if (/^Rp\s?[\d.]+$/.test(raw)) return;
      const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (digits) el.textContent = formatRupiahValue(digits);
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    attachPriceFormatter();
    formatDisplayedPrices();

    // Hindari MutationObserver global: halaman NEBO sering mengganti banyak DOM sekaligus.
    // Formatter dipasang saat modal/form dibuat oleh render berikutnya.
    window.attachPriceFormatter = attachPriceFormatter;
  });

  // Fungsi global supaya kode toko juga bisa memformat harga sebelum menyimpan.
  window.formatRupiah = formatRupiahValue;
})();

if(!location.hash){history.replaceState({page:'shop'},'', '#shop');}
window.addEventListener('popstate',function(){
  if(location.hash.startsWith('#product-')){
    const id=Number(location.hash.replace('#product-',''));
    openProduct(id,true);
  }else{
    showHome(true);
  }
});
</script>

function handleProductLink(id,event){
  const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);
  if(!p||!p.link||p.link.includes('example.com')){event?.preventDefault();alert('Link produk belum diisi melalui ADMIN.');return false}
  try{const u=new URL(p.link,location.href);if(!/^https?:$/.test(u.protocol)){event?.preventDefault();alert('Link produk tidak valid.');return false}}catch(e){event?.preventDefault();alert('Link produk tidak valid.');return false}
  trackAffiliateClick(id).catch(console.error);

products=products.map((p,i)=>({...p,active:p.active!==false,featured:!!p.featured,sold:Number(p.sold||0),createdAt:p.createdAt||p.id||Date.now()+i}));

function dbRow(p){
  const row={id:p.id,name:p.name,price:p.price,category:p.category,type:p.type,description:p.description||'',image:p.image||'',link:p.link||'',clicks:Number(p.clicks||0),sold:Number(p.sold||0),active:p.active!==false,featured:!!p.featured};
  if(p.createdAt) row.created_at=new Date(p.createdAt).toISOString();
  return row;
}
function fromDb(r){return {...r,active:r.active!==false,featured:!!r.featured,sold:Number(r.sold||0),clicks:Number(r.clicks||0),createdAt:r.created_at?new Date(r.created_at).getTime():Date.now()}}
async function loadProducts(){
  if(!SUPABASE_READY){return}
  const {data,error}=await sb.from('products').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  if(error){console.error('Gagal memuat database Supabase:',error); return}
  if(data) products=data.map(fromDb);
}
async function saveProductDb(p){
  const row=dbRow(p);
  let {data,error}=await sb.from('products').upsert(row).select().single();
  if(error && /sold/i.test(error.message||'')){
    const legacy={...row};delete legacy.sold;
    const retry=await sb.from('products').upsert(legacy).select().single();data=retry.data;error=retry.error;
  }
  if(error) throw error;
  return {...fromDb(data),sold:Number((data&&data.sold)??p.sold??0)};
}

async function uploadProductImage(file, productId){
  if(!SUPABASE_READY || !file) return null;
  if(!file.type.startsWith('image/')) throw new Error('File bukan gambar.');
  const blob=await compressImageToBlob(file,1200,.78);
  const ext='jpg';
  const path=`products/${productId}-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
  const {error}=await sb.storage.from('product-images').upload(path,blob,{contentType:'image/jpeg',upsert:true,cacheControl:'31536000'});
  if(error) throw error;
  const {data}=sb.storage.from('product-images').getPublicUrl(path);
  return data.publicUrl;
}

function compressImageToBlob(file,max=1200,quality=.78){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const reader=new FileReader();
    reader.onload=e=>{
      const img=new Image();
      img.onload=()=>{
        const scale=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(img.width,img.height));
        const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
        canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.width*scale));
        canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.height*scale));
        const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.drawImage(img,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
        canvas.toBlob(b=>b?resolve(b):reject(new Error('Gagal mengompres gambar.')),'image/jpeg',quality);
      };
      img.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('Foto tidak bisa diproses.'));
      img.src=e.target.result;
    };
    reader.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('Gagal membaca foto.'));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
async function deleteProductDb(id){const {error}=await sb.from('products').delete().eq('id',id);if(error)throw error}
async function incrementClickDb(id){
  const {data,error}=await sb.rpc('increment_product_click',{product_id:id});
  if(error) console.error(error);

async function ensureAdmin(userOverride=null){
  if(!SUPABASE_READY)return false;
  if(adminVerified && currentUser)return true;
  if(adminCheckPromise)return adminCheckPromise;
  adminCheckPromise=(async()=>{
    currentUser=userOverride||currentUser;
    if(!currentUser){
      const {data,error}=await sb.auth.getSession();
      if(error)throw error;
      currentUser=data.session?.user||null;
    }
    if(!currentUser){adminVerified=false;return false}
    const {data:profile,error}=await sb.from('profiles').select('role').eq('id',currentUser.id).maybeSingle();
    if(error){console.error('Gagal memeriksa role admin:',error);adminVerified=false;return false}
    if(profile?.role!=='admin'){adminVerified=false;alert('Akun ini belum memiliki akses admin.');try{await sb.auth.signOut()}catch(e){} currentUser=null;return false}
    adminVerified=true;return true;
  })();
  try{return await adminCheckPromise}finally{adminCheckPromise=null}
}
async function logout(){if(sb) await sb.auth.signOut(); currentUser=null; showHome()}

function openFeedback(){document.getElementById('modal').innerHTML=`<div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">HELP US IMPROVE</div><h2>Kirim Saran / Lapor Bug</h2></div><button class="close" onclick="closeModal()">×</button></div><p style="font-size:12px;color:#666;line-height:1.65">Kalau ada bagian website yang error, kurang nyaman, atau ada fitur yang ingin kamu sarankan, beritahu kami di sini.</p><div class="field"><label>JENIS FEEDBACK</label><select id="fb_type"><option>Bug / Error</option><option>Kenyamanan Website</option><option>Saran Fitur</option><option>Tampilan</option><option>Lainnya</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>PESAN</label><textarea id="fb_message" placeholder="Ceritakan masalah atau saran kamu..."></textarea></div><div class="field"><label>NAMA (OPSIONAL)</label><input id="fb_name" placeholder="Nama"></div><button class="btn" onclick="submitFeedback()">KIRIM FEEDBACK</button>`;document.getElementById('overlay').classList.add('show')}
function showToast(message){const el=document.getElementById('toast');if(!el)return;el.textContent=message;el.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(window.__neboToast);window.__neboToast=setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('show'),2200)}
function initAnimations(){if(window.__neboObserver)window.__neboObserver.disconnect();const els=document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){els.forEach(e=>e.classList.add('visible'));return}window.__neboObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('visible');window.__neboObserver.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -30px'});els.forEach(e=>window.__neboObserver.observe(e))}

async function submitFeedback(){const message=val('fb_message');if(!message)return alert('Tuliskan pesan terlebih dahulu.');const row={type:val('fb_type'),message,name:val('fb_name')||null,page:location.hash||'#shop'};let saved=false;if(SUPABASE_READY){try{const {error}=await sb.from('feedbacks').insert(row);if(!error)saved=true;else console.warn('Feedback Supabase:',error)}catch(e){console.warn(e)}}if(!saved){const list=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nebo_feedbacks')||'[]');list.unshift({...row,id:Date.now(),created_at:new Date().toISOString()});localStorage.setItem('nebo_feedbacks',JSON.stringify(list))}closeModal();showToast('Terima kasih. Feedback kamu sudah dikirim.')}
async function openFeedbackAdmin(){let list=[];if(SUPABASE_READY){try{const {data,error}=await sb.from('feedbacks').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100);if(!error&&data)list=data;else console.warn(error)}catch(e){console.warn(e)}}if(!list.length){try{list=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nebo_feedbacks')||'[]')}catch(e){}}document.getElementById('modal').innerHTML=`<div class="modal-head"><div><div class="eyebrow">VISITOR INPUT</div><h2>Feedback</h2></div><button class="close" onclick="closeModal()">×</button></div><div class="feedback-list">${list.length?list.map(x=>`<div class="feedback-item"><strong>${escapeHtml(x.type||'Feedback')}</strong> <small>${escapeHtml(x.name||'Anonim')} • ${x.created_at?new Date(x.created_at).toLocaleString('id-ID'):''}</small><p>${escapeHtml(x.message||'')}</p></div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty-state">Belum ada feedback.</div>'}</div>`;document.getElementById('overlay').classList.add('show')}
async function toggleProductActive(id){const i=products.findIndex(p=>p.id===id);if(i<0)return;const previous={...products[i]};products[i]={...products[i],active:!products[i].active};save();renderAdmin();showToast(products[i].active?'Produk ditampilkan di SHOP':'Produk disembunyikan dari SHOP');if(SUPABASE_READY){try{const saved=await saveProductDb(products[i]);products[i]=saved;save()}catch(e){products[i]=previous;save();renderAdmin();alert('Status gagal disimpan ke Supabase: '+e.message)}}}
function showHome(skipHistory=false){category='All';query='';shopSort='featured';renderHome();if(!skipHistory&&location.hash!=='#shop'){history.pushState({page:'shop'},'', '#shop')}}
function renderHome(){
document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=`<section class="hero hero-upgraded reveal"><div><div class="kicker">NEBO STORE / FASHION DISCOVERY</div><h1 data-site-hero-title>${escapeHtml(siteSettings.heroTitle||'FASHION,\nCURATED.')}</h1><div class="hero-badges"><span class="hero-badge">CURATED FINDS</span><span class="hero-badge">DIRECT TO STORE</span><span class="hero-badge">NEW DROPS</span></div></div><div><p class="hero-copy" data-site-hero-text>${escapeHtml(siteSettings.heroText||'')}</p><button class="btn" onclick="document.getElementById('selected').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">EXPLORE PRODUCTS →</button></div></section>
<section class="section selected-section" id="selected"><div class="topline"><div><div class="section-kicker">NEBO EDIT</div><h2>Selected Finds</h2></div><button class="view" onclick="document.getElementById('featured').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">NEXT →</button></div><div class="selected-grid" id="selectedGrid"></div></section>
<section class="section featured-section" id="featured"><div class="featured-head"><div><div class="featured-label">NEBO TOP 10 / PALING BANYAK DIBELI</div><h2 style="margin-top:7px">10 Produk Unggulan</h2></div><button class="view" onclick="document.getElementById('products').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'})">ALL PRODUCTS →</button></div><div id="featuredSpotlight"></div><div class="featured-grid" id="featuredGrid"></div></section>
<section class="section" id="products"><div class="topline"><div><div class="section-kicker">COMPLETE COLLECTION</div><h2>All Products</h2></div><div class="filters">${['All',...Array.from(new Set(activeProducts().map(p=>p.category).filter(Boolean)))].map(c=>`<button class="filter ${category===c?'active':''}" onclick="setCategory('${escapeAttr(c)}')">${escapeHtml(c).toUpperCase()}</button>`).join('')}</div></div>
<div class="controlbar"><input class="search" id="search" placeholder="Cari produk..." value="${escapeHtml(query)}" oninput="query=this.value;debouncedDrawProducts()"><select onchange="shopSort=this.value;drawProducts()"><option value="featured" ${shopSort==='featured'?'selected':''}>Featured dulu</option><option value="newest" ${shopSort==='newest'?'selected':''}>Terbaru</option><option value="popular" ${shopSort==='popular'?'selected':''}>Paling populer</option><option value="priceLow" ${shopSort==='priceLow'?'selected':''}>Harga terendah</option><option value="priceHigh" ${shopSort==='priceHigh'?'selected':''}>Harga tertinggi</option><option value="name" ${shopSort==='name'?'selected':''}>Nama A–Z</option><option value="saved" ${shopSort==='saved'?'selected':''}>Produk tersimpan</option></select></div><div class="grid" id="productGrid"></div></section>
<footer><img id="siteLogoFooter" src="${escapeAttr(document.getElementById('siteLogo')?.src||'')}" alt="NEBO STORE"><div><p>NEBO STORE — curated fashion finds untuk pria & wanita.</p><div class="social-strip" id="socialStrip"></div></div></footer><button class="feedback-fab" onclick="openFeedback()">SARAN / LAPOR BUG</button>`;applySiteSettings();drawSelectedFinds();drawFeatured();drawProducts();initAnimations()}
function drawSelectedFinds(){const grid=document.getElementById('selectedGrid');if(!grid)return;let list=activeProducts().filter(p=>p.featured).slice().sort((a,b)=>(Number(b.sold||0)-Number(a.sold||0))||(b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0)).slice(0,8);if(!list.length)list=activeProducts().slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0)).slice(0,8);grid.innerHTML=list.length?list.map((p,i)=>`<div class="reveal" style="transition-delay:${Math.min(i,7)*45}ms">${productCard(p,true)}</div>`).join(''):'<div class="empty-state">Belum ada produk pilihan.</div>';initAnimations()}
function debouncedDrawProducts(){clearTimeout(window.__neboSearchTimer);window.__neboSearchTimer=setTimeout(drawProducts,140)}
function drawFeatured(){
 const list=activeProducts().slice().sort((a,b)=>(Number(b.sold||0)-Number(a.sold||0))||(Number(b.clicks||0)-Number(a.clicks||0))||((b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0))).slice(0,10);
 const spot=document.getElementById('featuredSpotlight');if(spot)spot.innerHTML=list[0]?`<div class="featured-spotlight reveal"><div class="spotlight-photo" role="button" tabindex="0" onclick="openProduct(${list[0].id})">${list[0].image?`<img src="${escapeAttr(list[0].image)}" loading="eager" decoding="async" alt="${escapeAttr(list[0].name)}">`:'<div class="pictext">PRODUCT PHOTO</div>'}</div><div class="spotlight-copy"><div class="eyebrow">#1 PALING BANYAK DIBELI</div><h2>${escapeHtml(list[0].name)}</h2><div class="spotlight-price">${escapeHtml(list[0].price)}</div><p>${escapeHtml(list[0].description||'Salah satu pilihan favorit pengunjung NEBO STORE.')}</p><div class="top10-sales">${Number(list[0].sold||0).toLocaleString('id-ID')} terjual</div><button class="btn" onclick="openProduct(${list[0].id})">LIHAT PRODUK →</button></div></div>`:'<div class="empty-state">Belum ada produk untuk ditampilkan.</div>';
 const grid=document.getElementById('featuredGrid');if(grid){grid.className='top10-wrap';grid.innerHTML=list.map((p,i)=>`<article class="top10-card reveal"><span class="top10-rank">#${i+1}</span>${productCard(p,true)}</article>`).join('')||'<div class="empty-state">Belum ada produk unggulan.</div>'}initAnimations()}
function drawProducts(){let list=activeProducts().filter(p=>(category==='All'||p.category===category)&&(`${p.name} ${p.type} ${p.category} ${p.description}`.toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())));list.sort((a,b)=>{if(shopSort==='featured')return Number(b.featured)-Number(a.featured)||(b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0);if(shopSort==='popular')return (b.clicks||0)-(a.clicks||0);if(shopSort==='priceLow')return priceNumber(a)-priceNumber(b);if(shopSort==='priceHigh')return priceNumber(b)-priceNumber(a);if(shopSort==='name')return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);if(shopSort==='saved')return Number(isSaved(b.id))-Number(isSaved(a.id));return (b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0)});document.getElementById('productGrid').innerHTML=list.length?list.map(p=>productCard(p)).join(''):'<div class="empty-state">Produk tidak ditemukan. Coba kata kunci atau kategori lain.</div>'}
function setCategory(c){category=c;renderHome();requestAnimationFrame(()=>document.getElementById('products')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}))}
function openProduct(id,skipHistory=false){const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;if(!skipHistory){history.pushState({page:'product',id:id},'', '#product-'+id);}document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=`<section class="section detail-page"><button class="view" onclick="showHome()">← BACK TO SHOP</button><div class="detail" style="margin-top:30px"><div class="detail-photo" ${p.image?`role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="Zoom foto ${escapeAttr(p.name)}" onclick="openImageViewer(${p.id})" onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter'||event.key===' '){event.preventDefault();openImageViewer(${p.id})}" style="cursor:zoom-in"`:''}>${p.image?`<img src="${escapeAttr(p.image)}" alt="${escapeAttr(p.name)}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover">`:'<div class="pictext">PRODUCT PHOTO</div>'}</div><div class="detail-copy"><div class="eyebrow">${escapeHtml(p.category)} / ${escapeHtml(p.type)}</div><h1>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</h1><div class="detail-price">${escapeHtml(p.price)}</div><div class="price-disclaimer">Harga yang tampil di NEBO adalah harga saat link produk ditambahkan. <strong>Harga dapat berubah</strong> ketika kamu masuk ke toko sesuai harga terbaru dari penjual.</div><p class="desc">${escapeHtml(p.description||'Produk pilihan NEBO STORE. Lihat detailnya dan lanjutkan ke toko melalui link yang tersedia.')}</p><div class="detail-meta"><span>CURATED FIND</span><span>NEBO STORE</span></div><div class="product-actions"><a class="btn" href="${escapeAttr(p.link||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" onclick="return handleProductLink(${p.id},event)">VIEW PRODUCT ↗</a><button class="heart-btn ${isSaved(p.id)?'saved':''}" aria-label="Simpan produk" onclick="toggleSaved(${p.id})">${isSaved(p.id)?'♥':'♡'}</button></div><p class="detail-note">Kamu akan diarahkan ke toko untuk melihat detail, harga, dan melakukan pembelian.</p></div></div></section>`}
async function trackAffiliateClick(id){const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;p.clicks=(p.clicks||0)+1;if(SUPABASE_READY){await incrementClickDb(id)}else{save()}showToast('Mengarahkan ke toko...')}
async function affiliateClick(id){const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;if(p.link&&!p.link.includes('example.com')){window.open(p.link,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer');trackAffiliateClick(id)}else alert('Demo link. Ganti link affiliate produk ini melalui ADMIN.')}
async function loginAdmin(){
 const email=val('login_email'),password=document.getElementById('login_password').value;
 const msg=document.getElementById('login_msg');
 const btn=document.querySelector('.login-card .btn');
 if(!SUPABASE_READY){msg.textContent='Konfigurasi login belum siap.';return}
 if(!email||!password){msg.textContent='Email dan password wajib diisi.';return}
 if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='MEMERIKSA...'}
 msg.style.color='#777';msg.textContent='';
 const started=Date.now();
 try{
   const result=await Promise.race([
     sb.auth.signInWithPassword({email,password}),
     new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('Koneksi login terlalu lama. Coba jaringan yang lebih stabil.')),10000))
   ]);
   if(result.error)throw result.error;
   // Gunakan user hasil login langsung; jangan panggil getSession() kedua kali.
   currentUser=result.data?.user||null;
   if(!(await ensureAdmin(currentUser))){throw new Error('Akun ini tidak memiliki akses admin.')}
   adminVerified=true;
   // Jangan tahan dashboard menunggu download seluruh foto produk.
   renderAdmin();
   showToast('Login berhasil');
   loadProducts().then(function(){renderAdmin()}).catch(function(e){console.warn('Refresh data admin gagal:',e)});
 }catch(error){
   msg.style.color='#b33';msg.textContent=error.message||'Login gagal.';
 }finally{if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='LOGIN →'}}
}
async function showAdmin(){
 if(!SUPABASE_READY){showLogin();return}
 if(!currentUser || !adminVerified){if(!(await ensureAdmin())){showLogin();return}}
 renderAdmin();
}
function renderAdmin(){
 const list=adminProducts();const featuredCount=products.filter(p=>p.featured).length;const activeCount=products.filter(p=>p.active).length;const clicks=products.reduce((n,p)=>n+(p.clicks||0),0);
 document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=`<section class="section"><div class="topline"><div><div class="eyebrow">PRIVATE DASHBOARD</div><h2>NEBO STORE ADMIN</h2><p style="font-size:12px;color:#777">${escapeHtml(currentUser.email||'')}</p></div><div><button class="small" onclick="openSiteSettings()">WEBSITE SETTINGS</button> <button class="small" onclick="openFeedbackAdmin()">FEEDBACK</button> <button class="small" onclick="logout()">LOGOUT</button> <button class="btn" onclick="openAdd()">+ ADD PRODUCT</button></div></div><div class="stat-grid"><div class="stat"><small>TOTAL PRODUCTS</small><strong>${products.length}</strong></div><div class="stat"><small>ACTIVE</small><strong>${activeCount}</strong></div><div class="stat"><small>FEATURED</small><strong>${featuredCount}</strong></div><div class="stat"><small>TOTAL CLICKS</small><strong>${clicks}</strong></div></div><div class="admin-toolbar"><input placeholder="Cari produk..." value="${escapeAttr(adminQuery)}" oninput="adminQuery=this.value;debouncedRenderAdmin()"><select onchange="adminCategory=this.value;renderAdmin()"><option>All</option>${['All',...Array.from(new Set(products.map(p=>p.category).filter(Boolean)))].filter((c,i,a)=>a.indexOf(c)===i).map(c=>`<option ${adminCategory===c?'selected':''}>${escapeHtml(c)}</option>`).join('')}</select><select onchange="adminStatus=this.value;renderAdmin()"><option>All</option><option ${adminStatus==='Active'?'selected':''}>Active</option><option ${adminStatus==='Inactive'?'selected':''}>Inactive</option><option ${adminStatus==='Featured'?'selected':''}>Featured</option></select><select onchange="adminSort=this.value;renderAdmin()"><option value="newest" ${adminSort==='newest'?'selected':''}>Terbaru</option><option value="oldest" ${adminSort==='oldest'?'selected':''}>Terlama</option><option value="clicks" ${adminSort==='clicks'?'selected':''}>Klik terbanyak</option><option value="priceLow" ${adminSort==='priceLow'?'selected':''}>Harga terendah</option><option value="priceHigh" ${adminSort==='priceHigh'?'selected':''}>Harga tertinggi</option><option value="name" ${adminSort==='name'?'selected':''}>Nama A–Z</option></select></div><div style="overflow:auto"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr><th>PRODUCT</th><th>CATEGORY</th><th>PRICE</th><th>TERJUAL</th><th>CLICKS</th><th>SHOP</th><th>ACTION</th></tr></thead><tbody>${list.map(p=>`<tr><td><div class="admin-product">${p.image?`<img class="admin-thumb" src="${escapeAttr(p.image)}">`:''}<strong>${escapeHtml(p.name)}</strong></div></td><td>${escapeHtml(p.category)}</td><td>${escapeHtml(p.price)}</td><td>${Number(p.sold||0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}</td><td>${p.clicks||0}</td><td><button class="toggle-btn ${p.active?'on':''}" onclick="toggleProductActive(${p.id})">${p.active?'ON':'OFF'}</button></td><td><button class="small" onclick="openEdit(${p.id})">EDIT</button> <button class="small delete" onclick="deleteProduct(${p.id})">DELETE</button></td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div><p style="font-size:10px;color:#888;margin-top:25px">Database: Supabase • Auth: Supabase Auth • RLS aktif.</p></section>`
}
function debouncedRenderAdmin(){clearTimeout(window.__adminSearchTimer);window.__adminSearchTimer=setTimeout(renderAdmin,120)}
function adminProducts(){let list=products.filter(p=>{const q=adminQuery.toLowerCase();const matchQ=`${p.name} ${p.type} ${p.description}`.toLowerCase().includes(q);const matchC=adminCategory==='All'||p.category===adminCategory;const matchS=adminStatus==='All'||(adminStatus==='Active'&&p.active)||(adminStatus==='Inactive'&&!p.active)||(adminStatus==='Featured'&&p.featured);return matchQ&&matchC&&matchS});list.sort((a,b)=>{if(adminSort==='clicks')return (b.clicks||0)-(a.clicks||0);if(adminSort==='priceLow')return priceNumber(a)-priceNumber(b);if(adminSort==='priceHigh')return priceNumber(b)-priceNumber(a);if(adminSort==='name')return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);if(adminSort==='oldest')return (a.createdAt||0)-(b.createdAt||0);return (b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0)});return list}
function openAdd(){openForm(null)}

function previewProductImage(event){
  const file=event.target.files[0];
  if(!file)return;
  if(!file.type.startsWith('image/')){alert('Pilih file gambar yang valid.');event.target.value='';return;}
  const reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onload=e=>{
    document.getElementById('image_preview').innerHTML=`<img src="${e.target.result}" style="width:140px;height:140px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #ddd">`;
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function openEdit(id){openForm(products.find(p=>p.id===id))}
function openForm(p){const x=p||{name:'',price:'',category:'Men',type:'T-Shirt',description:'',image:'',link:'',sold:0,active:true,featured:false};document.getElementById('modal').innerHTML=`<div class="modal-head"><h2>${p?'EDIT':'ADD'} PRODUCT</h2><button class="close" onclick="closeModal()">×</button></div><div class="field"><label>PRODUCT NAME</label><input id="f_name" value="${escapeAttr(x.name)}"></div><div class="admin-grid"><div class="field"><label>PRICE</label><input id="f_price" placeholder="Rp89.000" value="${escapeAttr(x.price)}"></div><div class="field"><label>CATEGORY</label><select id="f_category">${['Men','Women','Unisex'].map(c=>`<option ${x.category===c?'selected':''}>${c}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><div class="field"><label>TYPE</label><input id="f_type" placeholder="T-Shirt / Pants / Jacket / Shoes..." value="${escapeAttr(x.type)}"></div><div class="field"><label>PRODUCT FOTO</label>

<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap">

  <label
    for="f_image_file"
    style="display:inline-block;padding:10px 16px;background:#111;color:#fff;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700"
  >
    + ADD FOTO
  </label>

  <input
    type="file"
    id="f_image_file"
    accept="image/*"
    style="display:none"
    onchange="previewProductImage(event)"
  >

  <input
    id="f_image"
    type="hidden"
    value="${escapeAttr(x.image)}"
  >

</div>
<div id="image_preview" style="margin-top:12px">
  ${
    x.image
      ? `<img src="${escapeAttr(x.image)}"
          style="width:140px;height:140px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid #ddd">`
      : ''
  }
</div></div><div class="admin-grid"><div class="field"><label>LINK PRODUK</label><input id="f_link" placeholder="Tempel link produk di sini" value="${escapeAttr(x.link)}"></div><div class="field"><label>JUMLAH TERJUAL</label><input id="f_sold" inputmode="numeric" value="${Number(x.sold||0)}"></div></div><div class="field"><label>DESCRIPTION</label><textarea id="f_desc">${escapeHtml(x.description)}</textarea></div><label class="featured-toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="f_featured" ${x.featured?'checked':''}> Tandai manual sebagai Featured Product</label><label class="featured-toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="f_active" ${x.active?'checked':''}> Produk aktif / tampil di toko</label><button class="btn" onclick="saveForm(${p?p.id:'null'})">SAVE PRODUCT</button>`;document.getElementById('overlay').classList.add('show');if(window.attachPriceFormatter)window.attachPriceFormatter()}
async function saveForm(id){
  const btn=document.querySelector('#modal .btn');
  if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='MENYIMPAN...'}
  const file=document.getElementById('f_image_file')?.files?.[0]||null;
  const data={name:val('f_name'),price:val('f_price'),category:val('f_category'),type:val('f_type'),image:val('f_image'),link:val('f_link'),description:val('f_desc'),sold:Number(val('f_sold').replace(/\D/g,''))||0,active:document.getElementById('f_active').checked,featured:document.getElementById('f_featured').checked};
  if(!data.name||!data.link){if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='SAVE PRODUCT'}alert('Nama produk dan link produk wajib diisi.');return}
  try{
    if(id===null){
      const newId=Date.now();
      if(SUPABASE_READY){
        if(file)data.image=await uploadProductImage(file,newId);
        const saved=await saveProductDb({id:newId,...data,clicks:0,createdAt:Date.now()});
        products.unshift(saved);
      }else{
        const reader=file?new FileReader():null;
        if(reader){reader.onload=()=>{};}
        const p={id:newId,...data,clicks:0,createdAt:Date.now()};
        if(file){const local=await compressImageToDataUrl(file);p.image=local}
        products.unshift(p);save();
      }
    }else{
      const i=products.findIndex(p=>p.id===id);if(i<0)throw new Error('Produk tidak ditemukan.');
      const p={...products[i],...data};
      if(SUPABASE_READY){
        if(file)p.image=await uploadProductImage(file,id);
        const saved=await saveProductDb(p);products[i]=saved;
      }else{
        if(file)p.image=await compressImageToDataUrl(file);
        products[i]=p;save();
      }
    }
    closeModal();showToast(file&&SUPABASE_READY?'Produk dan foto berhasil disimpan':'Produk berhasil disimpan');renderAdmin();
  }catch(e){alert('Gagal menyimpan: '+e.message)}finally{if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='SAVE PRODUCT'}}
}
function compressImageToDataUrl(file){
  return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const reader=new FileReader();reader.onload=e=>{const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{const scale=Math.min(1,1200/Math.max(img.width,img.height));const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.width*scale));c.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(img.height*scale));c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,c.width,c.height);resolve(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.78))};img.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('Foto tidak bisa diproses.'));img.src=e.target.result};reader.onerror=()=>reject(new Error('Gagal membaca foto.'));reader.readAsDataURL(file)
  });
}
async function deleteProduct(id){const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p)return;if(!confirm(`Hapus produk \"${p.name}\" secara permanen?`))return;const index=products.findIndex(x=>x.id===id);products=products.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();renderAdmin();showToast('Produk dihapus');if(SUPABASE_READY){try{await deleteProductDb(id)}catch(e){products.splice(index,0,p);products.sort((a,b)=>(b.createdAt||0)-(a.createdAt||0));save();renderAdmin();alert('Produk gagal dihapus dari Supabase. Jalankan SQL update terbaru agar admin memiliki izin DELETE.\n\n'+e.message)}}}
function closeModal(){document.getElementById('overlay').classList.remove('show')}function val(id){return document.getElementById(id).value.trim()}

function openImageViewer(id){
  const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!p||!p.image)return;
  let v=document.getElementById('imageViewer');
  if(!v){v=document.createElement('div');v.id='imageViewer';v.className='image-viewer';v.setAttribute('role','dialog');v.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');v.innerHTML='<button aria-label="Tutup" onclick="closeImageViewer()">×</button><img alt="" style="cursor:zoom-out">';v.addEventListener('click',function(e){if(e.target===v)closeImageViewer()});document.body.appendChild(v);}
  const img=v.querySelector('img');img.src=p.image;img.alt=p.name;v.classList.add('show');
}
function closeImageViewer(){const v=document.getElementById('imageViewer');if(v)v.classList.remove('show')}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeImageViewer()});

function escapeHtml(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[m]))}function escapeAttr(s){return escapeHtml(s)}
function showBootScreen(){
  loadLocalSiteSettings();
  document.getElementById('app').innerHTML=`<section class="boot-shell"><div class="boot-loader"><small>NEBO STORE</small><div class="bar"></div><div style="font-size:11px;color:#777;margin-top:12px">Memuat koleksi terbaru...</div></div></section>`;
}

async function boot(){
  // Jangan menampilkan snapshot lama lalu menggantinya beberapa saat kemudian.
  // Tampilkan loader ringan, ambil data terbaru, lalu render sekali.
  showBootScreen();
  if(!SUPABASE_READY){showHome(true);applySiteSettings();return}

  const loadStarted=Date.now();
  try{
    await Promise.race([
      Promise.all([loadProducts(),loadSiteSettings()]),
      new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('BOOT_TIMEOUT')),5000))
    ]);
    if(location.hash.startsWith('#product-')) openProduct(Number(location.hash.replace('#product-','')),true);
    else showHome(true);
  }catch(e){
    console.error('Gagal memuat data terbaru:',e);
    // Fallback hanya jika jaringan benar-benar lambat/gagal.
    showHome(true);
    applySiteSettings();
  }
  // Session check berjalan setelah UI tampil sehingga tidak menahan halaman.
  try{
    const {data}=await sb.auth.getSession();
    currentUser=data.session?.user||null;
    adminVerified=false;
    sb.auth.onAuthStateChange((_event,session)=>{
      currentUser=session?.user||null;
      if(!session){adminVerified=false;adminCheckPromise=null}
    });
  }catch(e){console.error('Gagal memeriksa sesi admin:',e)}
}
boot();
</script>
</body>
</html>
